idea: The other pond: two overdue regulars plus two cold numbers
why: The ledger says all ten of my picks leaned hot and most winning K4s came from Cold and Overdue with numbers I never touched, so this one fishes the other pond. 34 and 49 are regulars (25 and 26 draws in 100) that have now gone 11 games without a draw, the longest gaps after 71. 50 and 67 are among the coldest in the window (19 each) against a long-run rate of about 25 per 100. Kept clear of Agreement's 5 58 71 so the two tickets don't overlap.
